Resolve scales as shared or independent across panels

Source: R/facet.R
resolve_scale.Rd

The scale-resolution lattice (after Vega-Lite): for each aesthetic, choose whether faceted panels share one trained scale or train independent ones. Every scale defaults to "shared"; facet_*(scales = "free_*") is sugar for setting x/y to "independent".

Usage

resolve_scale(plot, ...)

Arguments

plot

A PlotSpec.

...

Named arguments mapping an aesthetic (x, y, color, size, ...) to "shared" or "independent".

Value

The modified PlotSpec.

Details

A non-position aesthetic (color, fill, size, alpha, shape, linetype, linewidth, pattern, ...) set to "independent" is trained in each panel from that panel's data alone, so each panel spends the whole palette or range on its own values, and each panel gets its own legend, drawn beside its panel (the guide position "panel"): right of each panel by default, or on the side theme(legend.position = ) names (left of, above or below each panel, or inside it). Each column of panels (or row, for legends above or below) gets a legend track as wide (tall) as its largest legend. To collect them in the legend area instead, give the guide a position, e.g. guides(color = guide_legend(position = "right")); they are then titled with the scale title and the panel's strip text ("hp (cyl: 4)"). Scales left shared keep their single legend. colour is an alias for color; fill is its own scale. A plot with a single panel ignores the setting.

Examples

vplot(mtcars) |> mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg) |> facet_wrap(~cyl) |>
  resolve_scale(y = "independent")


# one colour legend beside each panel
vplot(mtcars) |>
  mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(gear)) |>
  facet_wrap(~cyl) |>
  resolve_scale(color = "independent")


# the per-panel legends collected on the right instead
vplot(mtcars) |>
  mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(gear)) |>
  facet_wrap(~cyl) |>
  resolve_scale(color = "independent") |>
  guides(color = guide_legend(position = "right"))
